notes.title: Cooking Fest Demo
notes.content:
For a limited time you will be able to play The Witches' Whisk Demo on Steam for Steam's Cooking Fest!

How to play? Simply head over to our The Witches' Whisk on Steam between November 11th and November 18th and download the demo!

This version of the demo will only be available for a limited time, so don't miss your chance!

[b]The Cooking Fest Demo features the follow:[/b]
Core Gameplay Loop for Daily Time Management in your Bakery.
[list]
[*] 3 Magic Spells (Fire 🔥, Ice 🧊, Wind 💨).
[*] Ride your magic broom around the bakery!
[*] Pet the kitty and listen to hims (or hers) purr~
[/list]
The demo is available on [b]PC[/b], [b]macOS[/b] and [b]Linux/SteamOS[/b].

The full version of The Witches' Whisk will also have cake decorating, interior decorating as well as a full story mode and multiplayer. We'll also have character customization, familar customization for your cat companion and a full skill tree along with a full recipe book. We hope you enjoy this short demo that we put together just in time for Steam Cooking Fest and please follow us to keep an eye on the progress of The Witches' Whisk!

One more thing! To add to the fun, we've partnered with a handful of talented streamers to put together a compilation of great content from the demo! We'll be replaying their videos 24/7 during Cooking Fest!
